key_findings.finding: The ORD forward-prediction search returned two highly analogous records (ord-694d740d5e6949cf98f4bef271794458 and ord-c9066eba25a2456ca296cc9b9b6224f0) containing the specified ethyl bromoacetate, zinc, tetralin, bicyclic unsaturated ketone, and ethyl 4-[2-(tetralone-derived aryl)vinyl]benzoate. In both mapped reactions, the substrate's tetralone-derived ketone carbonyl is converted to a tertiary alcohol bearing a –CH2CO2Et substituent; the bicyclic unsaturated ketone and tetralin remain unmapped spectators in the product.
